result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.delete_nodes_ws()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Delete all selected nodes and their incident edges. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L934-L1011){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.delete_nodes_ws() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Removes nodes in the current selection from the graph, along with all edges connected to those nodes. Updates selection state and removes the selected nodes from the graph structure. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Delete middle nodes from a path: ::: {#2d62cfad .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph().add_path_graph(5) # Creates path: 0-1-2-3-4 # Select and delete middle nodes node_ids = list(graph.get_node_ids()) graph.select_nodes_by_id([node_ids[2], node_ids[3]]) graph.delete_nodes_ws() # 3 nodes remain (0, 1, 4) graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 3 ``` ::: ::: Check remaining edges after deletion: ::: {#3d7849a5 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph().add_path_graph(5) node_ids = list(graph.get_node_ids()) graph.select_nodes_by_id([node_ids[2], node_ids[3]]) graph.delete_nodes_ws() # Only edge 0-1 remains graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: Delete nodes by filtering on attributes: ::: {#ae13ea66 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A", value=10) .add_node(label="B", value=25) .add_node(label="C", value=30) .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") ) # Select and delete high-value nodes graph.select_nodes(lambda n: n.attributes.get("value", 0) > 20) graph.delete_nodes_ws() # Only node A remains graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` 1 ``` ::: :::
